saśca naśca iti khyātā dvitīyāvaraṇe nyaset
gurvaśca yaśca oṃ bhūta pretīśca nāśca vai ?
pānāyāhāśca vā aścadyoṃ hyotā aśca aścaja
dyontāśca ne bhavabhyāhyā gāvapinteśca yūśca yū
nenaśā yo vṛṣaścaiva guṃguṃ ghorāśca dyāśca te
vyaścaśca paścaśca mithaśca mīnātmā ca na
pāyūniya tattmaśca yaramin ma anāni ca
veśca vaśca visargeṇa mokṣaśca vaśaka eva ca
paśca vaiśca yo yaśca ruśca nayastathā
oṃ svaṃ ha phaśca yānyā ta brahmatāśca tathaiva ca
maśca bhūma anebhyo sa visargāma eva ca
peśca viśca tathādhī ca corvaṣṭa vastu eva ca
oṅkāraśca yavośi ca te śuyaśca punaśca phaṭ
sa sā hvūya ca taṃ hyā ca kilikeśaśca yastathā
svaśau śiyavāvākṣuśca vipārucāśca ma eva ca
khā cā cantapunargā ca haśca mo ca tato'kṣaraḥ
tathā tatra vakāraśca haśca yaśca yavo tataḥ
gamo svātmāśca vandaśca śastaṃgaśca phaṭ ca yat
yaśca taśca tathotkāraḥ parvau praṇava eva ca
annaṃ chindudvayaṃ kṣīṇa na padādaṣṭamaṃ padam
vṛkṣasaṅghe ca gokoṣṭhe payi bhasmani gomaye
evaṃ kṛtvā tu tanmantrī gacchetpratijalaṃ budhaḥ
mṛtpiṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇe haste gṛhṇīyāttu jalaṃ budhaḥ
nāntarjalena tiṣṭhañca na hasanna bruvan tathā
sarvāṅgulyā spṛśe hṛdayaṃ śiro vai sarvatoṅgulam
śiraḥ pādau tathābhyukṣaṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ sapta tṛptaye
ācamya vidhivatpūrvaṃ pādau hastau ca kṣālayet
śiro vaktrañca hṛdaya guhyaṃ pādau vibhāgaśaḥ
paścātsnānaṃ samāsādya ācamya ca yathā vidhi
devī kena tu tīrthena devān tarpyodapuṣpayuk
paitṛkena tu tīrthena pitṝn sarvāṃśca tarpayet
ācamya tu vidhānena vyomavyāpī tathaiva ca
huṅkāreṇa tu mantreṇa tīrthañcaiva tu saṃsmaret
nandā bhadrā ca surabhi suśīlā sumanāyataḥ
śivaṃ śuddha iti prokto arūpī avyayīśvaraḥ
hṛdayaṃ hṛdaye nyasya śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset
astraṃ hastena vinyasya netraṃ netreṇa vinyaset
pītaṃ śuklaṃ tathā raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhūmrābhavarṇakam
i ī cakṣurdvaye caiva u ū oṣṭhadvayorapi
e ai śrotradvaye caiva o au jihvāgale viduḥ
tasya madhye tu pūrvajño vyaktāvyaktamiti smṛtāḥ
āghorasya kulānāntu aṣṭau vai śaktayaḥ kramāt
kṛṣṇā mohā kṣudhā cintā grāmaṇī bhrāmiṇī tathā
visarjane tu tatkāle puṣpaṃ mūrdhni nidhāpayet
svabhāvataḥ śivaṃ proktaṃ kāṣṭhamadhye tu cāgnivat
rāgamāyā ca vidyāṃ ca kalāniyatireva ca
kartā bhoktā vidhātā cā dharttā dharmapatistathā
īśānaṃ kanakaṃ varṇaṃ vāmaṃ mukhamiti smṛtam
pīṭhe śaktiṃ samāvāhya tatra rū * * paṭhyate
ṣaḍviṃśati kalāhyete gaurī dehe tu vinyaset
vṛttapīṭhe sthito yogī gaurī āsanaṃ bhadrapīṭhake
na śivena vinā śaktiḥ na hitaśśivaḥ
yathā jātamidaṃ sarvaṃ tathā layaṃ prakīrtitam
evaṃ sandhyā tu manasā parāśaktistu janyase
saṃkrānte viṣuve pūjā na kartavyā kadācana
kuṃbhamadhye tu saṃsthāpya kiṃ liṅge nyāsayecchivam
vimalaṃ dakṣiṇe pūjya subāhuṃ vāmake yajet
saumye viṣṇuṃ samabhyarcya idaṃ viṣṇvīti mantrataḥ
astramantraṃ samuccārya paṭaṃ tatrā'pi nīya ca
garbhaṃgehaṃ tataḥ prāpya āsīno vā sthitastu vā
gulakā caturyugā caiva puruṣā na napuṃsakā
bāhudvayau ca karṇau ca vṛṣaṅgī vā samāyutam
bhasmaṃ datvā viśeṣeṇa tathā ṣoḍaśa sandhi vā
śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śuklañca dhūmrakam
tato gaurī ca yādyāyāṃ vāruṇe tu pradāpayet
śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇañcaiva vicitritam
evaṃ dhyātvā ca manasā sadāśivaṃ pūjayetkramāt
idaṃ viṣṇviti mantreṇa sāyaṃkāle su pūjayet
haviḥ kāle tu geyaṃ syādūrdhva nṛttantu kārayet
akṣaṇaṃ kārpāsabhasmañca tribhrāmya ca visṛjya ca
pīṭhāgre tu vinikṣipya evaṃ yaṃ kramānyaset
āhaṃ kālaṃ vinā yatra sāyaṃkāle tu rakṣakam
utsavāntaṃ śāntikaṃ proktaṃ tridhā karma samācaret
kīrtiṃ me tathā cāṣṭau vidyeśānāntu śaktyaḥ
mālinī ca umā caiva vajriṇī gaṇaśāna ca
kālakālī ca jātārī nīlī ca sukeśinī
vilāsinī virūpī ca dhāriṇī vimukhī tathā
lepayettu ca hṛnmantrī liṅgaṃ pīṭhañca gaurikā
arghye pralepane snāne triṣu gandhaṃ suyojayet
nivedya visarjane caiva vāri saptaṃ niyojayet
dhūpaṃ dadyāttu dīpena dīpaṃ dīpena yojayet
evaṃ kṛtvā tu manasā śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
gandhapuṣpañca dhūpañca dīpaṃ snānaṃ tathaiva ca
nīrājanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ gītaṃ nāṭyanṛttaṃ tathaiva ca
aparāhṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ mṛgā yatrākramaṃ kuru
śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ satvarajastamasa smṛtam
śvetaṃ sadyena dātavyaṃ raktaṃ vāmena mantrataḥ
bhadrī caiva mahābhadrī droṇarūpaṃ tathaiva ca
āmalīphalamātre vā aṣṭiṃ vā bali dāpayet
pūjā parisamāpte tu mukhaṃ gatvā bahisthitam
saṃyojya hastau dvau kartau antare suṣaraṃ kṛtam
muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā caturhaste karapṛṣṭhe tu yojane
tayoragre tu saṃlagnau śeṣāśca visṛtāśca yaḥ
uttānau tu karau paścānmaṇi bandhantu kārayet
aṃkāre tu tilaṃ proktaṃ aṃkāre sa tukaṃ nyaset
jalaṃ mṛdāṃbha ityuktaṃ ḍhakāreṇa tu vinyaset
śakāre gandhatailaṃ syāt ṣakāre cama vinyaset
dravyalābhe jalaṃ pūrya iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ
iti homaṃ pratantavyaṃ tasyāgre tu viśeṣataḥ
saptāhe caiva pañcāhe tryahe vā viśeṣataḥ
upakuṃbhantu nikṣipya jalaṃ vā kṣīrameva vā
snapanaṃ tu yathā śaktyā yathoktaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ
prāk sūtrantu sūtraṃ syādudak sūtraṃ tathaiva ca
yo rudra iti mantreṇa udak sūtraṃ tathaiva ca
astradevaṃ samabhyarcya madhye patre tu rudrakam
gaurīṃ madhyamamūle tu sarasvatīṃ dakṣiṇaṃ tathā
tadvāre tu mahālakṣīṃ gosthāne tu sarasvatīm
īśāne sundarī caiva devikoṣṭhe baliṃ kṣipet
dvātriṃśena baliṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśaṃ dinameva ca
balisaṃkhyā iti proktā utsavasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu
pratiṣṭhādutsavā hīne yatheṣṭaṃ māsi vā nayet
prārabdhamutsave hīne yatheṣṭaṃ māsi vā nayet
dhvaje dhvajo na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam
madhye samatalaṃ kṛtvā madhye sthaṇḍilameva ca
antarbaliṃ kramaṃ pūrvaṃ yāgānte vā baliṃ kṣipet
tadgīvasya samaṃ vā'pi gopurasya samantu vā
nava piṇḍaṃ tataḥ kuryāddig dikṣu ca meva hi
śivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryāt gomayena tu lepayet
svaśraṃ rataṃ vāpi athavā kārpāsameva ca
sthalikāṃ taṇḍule caiva tanmadhye tantu rakṣakam
aindre ca pāvake vā'tha yamo vai rākṣase'pi vā
tanmadhye nalinaṃ likhya aṣṭapatraṃ sa karṇikam
homānte tu baliṃ kuryāt mekhalopari vinyaset
āhūya pādyakaṃ paścāt ācāryaśśiṣya eva ca
chatrantu cāmarau caiva vyajanaṃ dhvajameva ca
hṛdayena tu mantreṇa puṣpaṃ śirasi vinyaset
evaṃ saptavidhaṃ kuryāt mahānāṭyaṃ tathaiva ca
taṃ madhye lalitaṃ kuryāt tripādī tatra vinyaset
homānte tu nivedyaṃ syāt tāṃbūlantu nivedayet
kṛtvā tu snapanaṃ tatra mūlamantreṇa hūyate
śailajaṃ lohajaṃ vā'pi saudhajaṃ ratnajaṃ tathā
śilā parīkṣitāñcaiva savyaṃ vai strīśilā budhaḥ
lohaje tu madhūcchiṣṭaṃ saṅgrahe tu vicakṣaṇaḥ
tathaiva mānahīnaṃ vā tanmānaṃ vā gṛhe punaḥ
guṇena guṇitaṃ yatra dusvaive vasubhiḥ kramāt
vāme vā dakṣiṇe vā'pi sthāpanīyaṃ manonmanī
aiśe vā pāvake vā'tha aindre vā somameva vā
ekāhe vā tathā caiva ratnanyāsaṃ tathā bhavet
nīlaṃ vai yāmyadigbhāge gometakaṃ nir-ṛtī tathā
rātrau yatyantake caiva jananī vā rathe sthitam
dārujaṃ phalakā caiva mukulaṃ kevalaṃ tathā
sthāpanaṃ caiva sānnidhya sannirodhaṃ tathaiva ca
caruṃ vai ghoramantreṇa lājaṃ vāmena hūyate
śirasā ca talaṃ hutvā pratyekaṃ vividhāṣṭakam
arghyaṃ datvā viśeṣeṇa puṣpaṃ mūrdhni ca dāpayet
hṛdaye ca gale bāhyoḥ jaṭhare nābhideśake
athavā tu trayodaśyāṃ tato gandha pavitrakam
janān sarvān pradātavyaṃ karṇikān sa pavitrakam
evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyassa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt
śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śyāmaṃ tathā nyaset
dagdhalī * ca kṛṣṇaṃ syāt pādaṃ pratikṛtaṃ kṛti
niṣkaṃ vā'pi tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdhamathāpi vā
dūrataḥ śikharaṃ dṛṣṭvā yo naraḥ praṇamaśśivam
janaispṛṣṭā tathāyāśca bhūloke tu su jīvatu
pade pade śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
ārāmaṃ devadevasya yo naraḥ kṛtavān bhuvi
navadhā snapanaṃ kurvan yo naro bhaktisaṃyutaḥ
navamārge tu yatkarma bhoge'pi navadhā bhavet
dhūpaghaṇṭā tu yo dadyā * * nir-ṛti śiṣyate
tatrā'pi bhūyaye caiva tasya svargaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
sālokyaṃ caiva sāmīpyaṃ sāyujyañcaiva yeva hi
rātrau tu vā baliṃ kuryāt sarveṣāṃ balimācaret
tanmadhye tu tripāṭīnāṃ sthaṇḍiktān taṇḍulaṃ bhavet
dhruvaṃ kā aparārpāṇyā tiṣyaṃ bandhāpi sarjanam
tatsaṃkhyā kāṣṭhakārī ca gopālānāṃ tathaiva ca
dīpānāṃ bhogamevaṃ taṃ gandhārdhaṃ bhogameva tu
anyeṣu prāṅmukho bhūtvā sṛk sruvaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ
kālī caiva karālī ca manoramā ca sulohitā
rudrañca vāruṇe kuṇḍe bhīmaṃ vai vāyugocare
caturaśraṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā ekāṃśaṃ purato nyaset
īśāne sadāśivaṃ mantraṃ pūrve tu īśamantrakam
uttare brahmamantrantu yathā śaktyā tu homayet
dīyate tu śivajñānaṃ kṣīyate tu malatrayam
ādi śaivaṃ viprāṇāṃ śivena dīkṣita smṛtaḥ
aṣṭamasthān gṛhān sarvān parihāre tu viśeṣataḥ
tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā aṣṭavakraṃ sa karṇakam
na tasya jāyate mṛtyuriti śāstrasya niścayaḥ
mantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tatvādhvā bhuvanādhvakam
svarṇādhvā me hṛddeśe tu pādayostu talādhvakam
e ai tālurandhreṣu o au dantadvaye'pi ca
paphau dakṣiṇapārśve ca bāho vai vāmaparśvake
śrepisaṅke valādīni yāgne yāne daśāni ca
varo'ṣṭanā ca saṃśodhya śubhe vāstuṃ samārabhet
sātvikaṃ nāgaraṃ proktaṃ rājasaṃ drāvilaṃ bhavet
pādabandhaṃ va prabandhaṃ kaṃ prabandhamiti smṛtam
tasyotsedhaṃ rasāṃśe tu kuryādaṃśena dhṛk bhavet
